# Most World Curling Championship titles (female)
![Most World Curling Championship titles \(female\)](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/images/css/gwr-ph.jpg)

[ Contact an Account Manager ](https://business.guinnessworldrecords.com/contact-us?source=Website-EN-B2B%20Form) Who
    Canada What
     19 total number  Where
     Korea (Republic of) (Uijeongbu)  When
     23 March 2025 
The most World Women's Curling Championship titles is 19, achieved by Canada in 1980, 1984–87, 1989, 1993–94, 1996–97, 2000–01, 2004, 2007–08, 2017–2018 and 2024–25.
Canada extended their record with a 19th title at the 2025 World Women’s Curling Championship in in Uijeongbu, South Korea. They defeated Switzerland 7–3 in the final on 23 March 2025.
Records change on a daily basis and are not immediately published online. For a full list of record titles, please use our Record Application Search. (You will need to register / login for access)
